title: Proposed Maui County passenger ferry to Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi
summary: On November 13, Bill 152, which would establish a County ferry system, was tabled with no objections. At a September 17 community meeting, staff said the project is "not a done deal": a private company would run a passenger-only ferry under a bid contract, with Molokaʻi service hoped for by early 2029. Lānaʻi service is estimated to cost about $5 million a year, with tickets covering about $3 million, and a draft environmental assessment will be released for comment.

timeline.text: The Maui County Council's ADEPT Committee listed the Maui County Ferry Feasibility Study on its master agenda.

timeline.text: The County announced special ferry and shuttle options for Lānaʻi and Molokaʻi residents to attend the 99th Maui County Fair, including a $25 boat and bus package from Molokaʻi.

source.quote: Molokaʻi residents are also invited to make the trip to the Maui County Fair with a special $25 boat and bus shuttle package.

timeline.text: Maui Now reported the county's procurement target: a request for proposals in January 2027 and a Lānaʻi launch in mid-2027. The page does not mention these dates.

source.quote: The goal is to put out a request for proposals in January 2027 and launch Lāna'i service in mid-2027.

timeline.text: The County held the last of its four community ferry meetings on Lānaʻi, outlining procurement and service launch targets, including mid-2027 for Lānaʻi service.

source.quote: The County is targeting mid-2027 for Lānaʻi ferry service to begin under a County-supported system.
